narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Put them in a row: six C symbols, four X symbols and five I symbols.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Roman numerals do not repeat a symbol that many times.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Each full group must become a bigger symbol.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Gather the same symbols, then turn each full group into a bigger symbol.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. Add X V I I and X X V I I I without changing them to our numerals.
